column1: # Tiers: kernel, api, data, server (area modules <area>-api/-data/-server; rank kernel < api < data < server,
# layering rules R6, R7: api/contract depend only on kernel/api/contract), contract (alias of api), feature (alias of server), client-lib/app/shell (ui area,
# rules R2/R5, unranked), host. Existing `data` modules (:platform-server-common, :accounting-einvoice,
# :accounting-banking, :fiscal-export, :fiscal-process-data, :ecr-receipt, :pos-tse) are ranked as `data`; R6 found no violation among current modules.
# R6 cross-area: another area's `server` tier is off limits, except `platform` (the foundation area every server may use, spec section 15).
# The former :core-data and :shared blobs were split into the <area>-data / <area>-api modules (Stages B2-1b..B2-5) and dissolved in B2-5 C2 / C3.
